faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: KmhFlix is a streaming service that offers a wide variety of award-winning movies, TV shows, and more. Watch as much as you want, anytime you want.
faq.a2: Watch KmhFlix on your smartphone, tablet, Smart TV, or laptop for a fixed monthly fee. Plans range from $7.99 to $19.99 a month.
faq.a3: Watch anywhere, anytime. Sign in with your KmhFlix account to watch instantly on any internet-connected device.
faq.a4: KmhFlix is flexible. There are no annoying contracts and no commitments. You can easily cancel your account online in two clicks.
faq.q5: What can I watch on KmhFlix?
faq.a5: KmhFlix has an extensive library of feature films, documentaries, TV shows, anime, award-winning KmhFlix originals, and more.
faq.a6: The KmhFlix Kids experience is included in your membership to give parents control while kids enjoy family-friendly TV shows and films.
